description: Search the Evolith architecture knowledge corpus (ADRs, rulesets, standards) with BM25-first hybrid retrieval. Returns ranked chunks with full citations. Optimised for exact identifiers such as ADR-0111 as well as natural-language questions.

adrPrefix.description: Restrict to ADR ids starting with this prefix.

includeText.description: Include the full chunk text, not just the preview (default false).

language.description: Restrict to a corpus language (en, es).

query.description: Search text. An exact identifier (ADR-0111, GT-569) or a natural-language question.

sourcePrefix.description: Restrict to source paths starting with this prefix.

name: evolith-knowledge-search

outputSchema.description: Envelope returned by every Evolith MCP tool, mirrored verbatim in `structuredContent`. `success: true` carries `data`; `success: false` carries `error`. Envelope schema version 1.0.0.

data.description: Ranked chunks from the Evolith architecture knowledge corpus.

items.description: One retrieved corpus chunk with full citation and retrieval provenance.

adrId.description: ADR number when the source is an ADR.

charEnd.description: End offset of the chunk in its source file.

charStart.description: Start offset of the chunk in its source file.

corpusVersion.description: Indexed corpus release the chunk was embedded under.

denseRank.description: 1-based rank in the dense list, absent if dense did not return it.

lexicalRank.description: 1-based rank in the BM25 list, absent if BM25 did not return it.

retrievedBy.description: Which retrievers surfaced this chunk. An exact-term match and a semantic neighbour carry different confidence.

score.description: Fused relevance score. Comparable within one response only.

sectionHeading.description: Heading of the section the chunk came from.

sourceFile.description: Repo-relative path of the source document.

text.description: Full chunk text. Omitted unless `includeText` is true.

retrievalMode.description: hybrid = BM25 fused with a dense reranker; lexical-only = BM25 alone (no embedding sidecar, or the dense side failed and the search degraded rather than returning nothing).

terms.description: Normalized lexical terms the query was tokenized into. Exposed so an agent can see why an identifier query matched.

totalChunks.description: Size of the indexed corpus the query ran against.

error.description: Present when `success` is false. `code` is machine-readable and append-only.

code.description: Stable Evolith error code. FORBIDDEN covers every ABAC / scope / approval refusal.

meta.description: ADR-0073 envelope metadata. Identical across the CLI, REST and MCP surfaces.

command.description: ADR-0073 canonical name of the invoked operation.

context.description: Verbatim echo of the caller-supplied execution context.

durationMs.description: Server-side wall time of the call.

schemaVersion.description: Pinned envelope shape version. Bumped only on a breaking envelope change.

success.description: Whether the operation completed. Not the governance verdict.

outputSchema.title: EvolithMcpOutputEnvelope
